question.knowledge_point: Solving for an Unknown Given the Value of a Minor
question.problem:
Given that the minor of ${p}_{23}$ is ${t}^{2}+12$, find all the possible values of $t$ in the matrix

$$
P=[\begin{aligned}t & -8 & 3 \\ -7 & 4 & 4 \\ -1 & 9 & 0\end{aligned}].
$$
question.worked_solution:
First, we remove the second row and third column:

$$
P=[\begin{aligned}t & -8 & ∗ \\ ∗ & ∗ & 4 \\ -1 & 9 & ∗\end{aligned}]
$$

The minor of ${p}_{23}$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{det}[\begin{aligned}t & -8 \\ -1 & 9\end{aligned}] & =|\begin{aligned}t & -8 \\ -1 & 9\end{aligned}| \\  & =t\cdot 9-(-8)\cdot (-1) \\  & =9t-8.\end{aligned}
$$

We're told that the minor of ${p}_{23}$ is ${t}^{2}+12$, so we must have:

$$
\begin{aligned}9t-8 & ={t}^{2}+12 \\ {t}^{2}-9t+20 & =0 \\ (t-5)(t-4) & =0\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solutions are $t=4$ and $t=5.$
